guitar.evidence: Andy Powell of Wishbone Ash is well documented as a long-time Gibson Flying V player, distinctive among 70s twin-guitar harmony rock bands.

tone.target: bright twin-guitar British crunch with light modulation
tone.profile: bright twin-guitar British crunch with light modulation
tone.summary: A bright, articulate signal chain using a Vox-style preamp and UK 4x12 cabinet, enhanced by a Boost for bite and Chorus for subtle width.
corrections: replace mid-scooped lead with upper-mid bite
lean more Wishbone Ash harmony rock than generic blues

rig.name: Wishbone Ash - Blowin' Free - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide the necessary 'crunch' and upper-mid bite characteristic of British rock tones.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a light, articulate boost/overdrive rather than heavy saturation.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if more grit is desired)

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on natural amp crunch.
blocks.gap: No dedicated distortion module is needed; the Green OD provides sufficient saturation for 'crunch'.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate sound of a Vox/Marshall-style British clean/crunch amp.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP is ideal for achieving the desired upper-mid focus and chimey quality.

alternatives.model: AC30 TB (if more classic Brit rock tone is needed)

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet sound that complements the UK SLP preamp.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (if a slightly more open, less defined tone is desired)

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper-mids and treble to achieve 'clear upper mids' and bite.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical tone shaping, focusing on articulation and chime.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and movement ('light modulation') without sounding like a heavy phaser/chorus sweep.
blocks.gap: The WAH module is used in a non-sweeping, light tremolo/vibrato manner to achieve the 'chimey sustain' effect subtly.

alternatives.model: Chorus (if more obvious modulation is desired)

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the twin-lead harmony without cluttering the mix.
blocks.gap: Kept minimal to support the 'twin lead blend' concept without sounding overly echoey.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural sense of space and glue the lead lines together.
blocks.gap: A subtle room reverb is preferred over plate/spring to maintain the dry, articulate British rock feel.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more polished sound is desired)

improvements.summary: Refine cabinet choice for maximum upper-mid clarity and chime.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, articulate British crunch tone.
